title: Why Ice Cream Attacks Your Forehead — And the Tongue Fix
caption:
That ice cream headache has a name: brain freeze!
A cartoon guy inhales a giant sundae, then freezes solid in ice as the pain hits his forehead.
Ice on your palate spasms the sphenopalatine ganglion — press your tongue to the roof of your mouth to thaw it fast.
Ever been ambushed by brain freeze mid-scoop?
Save this trick before your next summer scoop!
